Definition: Whether credentials are issued free of charge
Comments: The nigeridentite.com portal lists fees for the E-ID card: 5,000 FCFA for the card (valid 10 years) plus a 1,000 FCFA dossier processing fee. There is a monetary cost to obtain the digital ID credential.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Verified: a fee applies. Niger's new national biometric ID card (CNIB-AES), launched March-April 2026 and confirmed by state news agencies Le Sahel/ONEP and ANP, costs 4,500 FCFA (standard) or 9,000 FCFA (express); the nigeridentite.com E-ID portal separately lists 5,000+1,000 FCFA. The original row's own comment already described a fee, yet was coded 2=Yes (free) — an internal contradiction under the 1=No/2=Yes scale. Corrected to 1=No (not free), now corroborated by three independent sources.

Definition: Whether non-nationals including refugees, asylum seekers, and permanent residents are eligible to register
Comments: The WURI (World Bank) foundational ID system, of which Niger is a Phase 2 participant, is explicitly designed for 'all persons physically in the territory of a country, irrespective of nationality, citizenship or legal status.' This inclusive approach covers refugees, stateless persons, and non-nationals. The WURI PAD confirms this universal coverage principle.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed by corroborating sources: the WB PAD and WB knowledge-repository report both state Niger's WURI foundational ID (NUI) is designed for 'all persons physically in the territory... irrespective of nationality, legal status or residency'; UNHCR's October 2024 Niger update shows this is applied in practice, with biometric registration and ID-card issuance for Malian and Nigerian refugees via the CNE. However, Niger's newer CNIB-AES biometric national ID card (launched March-April 2026, per Le Sahel/ANP) requires a certificat de nationalité, restricting that specific credential to citizens. Score of 3=All retained on WURI/NUI evidence, but flagged for human review to confirm which system this variable should track given the newer citizen-only card.
